name: merge-watch
description: A panel that groups every open merge request or pull request by whether it can merge, shows failing jobs, and can retry or merge after you confirm. Refreshed once a minute.

github_token.title: GitHub token (GitHub repositories only)
github_token.description: A read-only GitHub token for pull requests, checks, actions and commit statuses. Stored in secure storage. Leave empty for GitLab projects, or set GITHUB_TOKEN in Claude Code's environment instead.

github_hosts.title: GitHub Enterprise hosts
github_hosts.description: Comma-separated GitHub Enterprise hostnames, e.g. github.example.com. github.com is always recognised.

gitlab_hosts.title: Extra self-hosted GitLab hosts
gitlab_hosts.description: Comma-separated GitLab hostnames that do not contain the word gitlab. gitlab.com and gitlab.* hosts are always recognised.
